lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਅਚੁਤ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਾਰਣਹ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: preetam bhagavaan achut || naanak sa(n)saar saagar taaranah ||14||
lines.translation: The Beloved Eternal Lord God, O Nanak, carries us across the world-ocean. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੰ ਬਿਸਰਣੰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ॥ ਜੀਵਣੰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਧੵਾਵਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: marana(n) bisarana(n) gobi(n)dah || jeevana(n) har naam dhyaavanah ||
lines.translation: It is death to forget the Lord of the Universe. It is life to meditate on the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਭਣੰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਣਹ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: labhana(n) saadh sa(n)gen || naanak har poorab likhanah ||15||
lines.translation: The Lord is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, by pre-ordained destiny. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਸਨ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਭੁਯੰਗੰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਗਾਰੁੜੀ ਨਿਵਾਰੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: dasan bihoon bhuya(n)ga(n) ma(n)tra(n) gaaruRee nivaara(n) ||
lines.translation: The snake-charmer, by his spell, neutralizes the poison and leaves the snake without fangs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੵਾਧਿ ਉਪਾੜਣ ਸੰਤੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: byaadh upaaRan sa(n)ta(n) ||
lines.translation: Just so, the Saints remove suffering;

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਬਧ ਕਰਮਣਹ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak labadh karamanah ||16||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they are found by good karma. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਥ ਕਥ ਰਮਣੰ ਸਰਣੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਜੀਅਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: jath kath ramana(n) sarana(n) sarabatr jeeanah ||
lines.translation: The Lord is All-pervading everywhere; He gives Sanctuary to all living beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਥ ਲਗਣੰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨਾਨਕ ॥ ਪਰਸਾਦੰ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨਹ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: tath lagana(n) prem naanak || parasaada(n) gur darasanah ||17||
lines.translation: The mind is touched by His Love, O Nanak, By Guru's Grace, and the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਮਨ ਬਿਧੵੰ ॥ ਸਿਧੵੰ ਸਰਬ ਕੁਸਲਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: charanaarabi(n)d man bidhy(n) || sidhy(n) sarab kusalanah ||
lines.translation: My mind is pierced through by the Lord's Lotus Feet. I am blessed with total happiness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਥਾ ਗਾਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਬੵੰ ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਣਹ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: gaathaa gaava(n)t naanak bhaby(n) paraa poorabanah ||18||
lines.translation: Holy people have been singing this Gaat'haa, O Nanak, since the very beginning of time. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਭ ਬਚਨ ਰਮਣੰ ਗਵਣੰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਉਧਰਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: subh bachan ramana(n) gavana(n) saadh sa(n)gen udharanah ||
lines.translation: Chanting and singing the Sublime Word of God in the Saadh Sangat, mortals are saved from the world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਲਭੵਤੇ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)saar saagara(n) naanak punarap janam na labhyte ||19||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they shall never again be consigned to reincarnation. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed puraan saasatr beechaara(n) ||
lines.translation: People contemplate the Vedas, Puraanas and Shaastras.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਨਾਮ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: eka(n)kaar naam ur dhaara(n) ||
lines.translation: But by enshrining in their hearts the Naam, the Name of the One and Only Creator of the Universe,

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਲਹ ਸਮੂਹ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: kulah samooh sagal udhaara(n) ||
lines.translation: everyone can be saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋ ਤਾਰੰ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: badabhaagee naanak ko taara(n) ||20||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, O Nanak, a few cross over like this. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਣੰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮੰ ਉਧਰਣੰ ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: simarana(n) gobi(n)d naama(n) udharana(n) kul samoohanah ||
lines.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of Lord of the Universe, all one's generations are saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਬਧਿਅੰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਭੇਟੰਤਿ ਦਰਸਨਹ ॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: labadhia(n) saadh sa(n)gen naanak vadabhaagee bheta(n)t darasanah ||21||
lines.translation: It is obtained in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. O Nanak, by great good fortune, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is seen. ||21||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਦੋਖ ਪਰੰਤਿਆਗੀ ਸਰਬ ਧਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੰਤਣਃ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab dokh para(n)tiaagee sarab dharam driRa(n)tanah ||
lines.translation: Abandon all your evil habits, and implant all Dharmic faith within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਬਧੇਣਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖੵਣਃ ॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: labadhen saadh sa(n)gen naanak masatak likhynah ||22||
lines.translation: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is obtained, O Nanak, by those who have such destiny written upon their foreheads. ||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਯੋ ਹੈ ਹੋਵੰਤੋ ਹਰਣ ਭਰਣ ਸੰਪੂਰਣਃ ॥
lines.transliteration: hoyo hai hova(n)to haran bharan sa(n)pooranah ||
lines.translation: God was, is, and shall always be. He sustains and destroys all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਤਮ ਜਾਣੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਾਰਣੰ ॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo satam jaano naanak preet kaarana(n) ||23||
lines.translation: Know that these Holy people are true, O Nanak; they are in love with the Lord. ||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੇਣ ਬੈਣ ਰਤਨੰ ਰਚਨੰ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਰੰਗਣਃ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukhen bain ratana(n) rachana(n) kasu(n)bh ra(n)ganah ||
lines.translation: The mortal is engrossed in sweet words and transitory pleasures which shall soon fade away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਬਿਓਗੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੁਪਨਹ ॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: rog sog bioga(n) naanak sukh na supanah ||24||
lines.translation: Disease, sorrow and separation afflict him; O Nanak, he never finds peace, even in dreams. ||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫੁਨਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: phunahe mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Phunhay, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾਥਿ ਕਲੰਮ ਅਗੰਮ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖਾਵਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: haath kala(n)m aga(n)m masatak lekhaavatee ||
lines.translation: With Pen in Hand, the Unfathomable Lord writes the mortal's destiny upon his forehead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪਾਵਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: urajh rahio sabh sa(n)g anoop roopaavatee ||
lines.translation: The Incomparably Beautiful Lord is involved with all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਤੁਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: usatat kahan na jaai mukhahu tuhaareeaa ||
lines.translation: I cannot utter Your Praises with my mouth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mohee dekh daras naanak balihaareeaa ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak is fascinated, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਕਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਮੈ ਕਹਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t sabhaa mahi bais k keerat mai kahaa(n) ||
lines.translation: Seated in the Society of the Saints, I chant the Lord's Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਰਪੀ ਸਭੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਸਭੁ ਦਿਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: arapee sabh seegaar ehu jeeu sabh divaa ||
lines.translation: I dedicate all my adornments to Him, and give all this soul to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੁ ਕੰਤਿ ਵਿਛਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: aas piaasee sej s ka(n)t vichhaaeeai ||
lines.translation: With hopeful yearning for Him, I have made the bed for my Husband.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਤ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: harihaa(n) masatak hovai bhaag ta saajan paaeeai ||2||
lines.translation: O Lord! If such good destiny is inscribed upon my forehead, then I shall find my Friend. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਕਾਜਲ ਹਾਰ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਸਭੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sakhee kaajal haar ta(n)bol sabhai kichh saajiaa ||
lines.translation: O my companion, I have prepared everything: make-up, garlands and betel-leaves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਲਹ ਕੀਏ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਕਿ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਜਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: solah keee seegaar k a(n)jan paajiaa ||
lines.translation: I have embellished myself with the sixteen decorations, and applied the mascara to my eyes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਤ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: je ghar aavai ka(n)t ta sabh kichh paaeeai ||
lines.translation: If my Husband Lord comes to my home, then I obtain everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਕੰਤੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: harihaa(n) ka(n)tai baajh seegaar sabh birathaa jaaeeai ||3||
lines.translation: O Lord! Without my Husband, all these adornments are useless. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਕੰਤੁ ਸਾ ਵਡਭਾਗਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis ghar vasiaa ka(n)t saa vadabhaagane ||
lines.translation: Very fortunate is she, within whose home the Husband Lord abides.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਣਿਆ ਹਭੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਾਈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis baniaa habh seegaar saaee sohaagane ||
lines.translation: She is totally adorned and decorated; she is a happy soul-bride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਸੁਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਪੁਰਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau sutee hoi achi(n)t man aas puraaeeaa ||
lines.translation: I sleep in peace, without anxiety; the hopes of my mind have been fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਜਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਕੰਤੁ ਤ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: harihaa(n) jaa ghar aaiaa ka(n)t ta sabh kichh paaeeaa ||4||
lines.translation: O Lord! When my Husband came into the home of my heart, I obtained everything. ||4||
